name: Keystone Newsroom (PA statewide news/food readers' polls)
credible: PA statewide newsroom running crowd-sourced Best-of food guides; used to measure/cite Erie reader consensus (sushi, coffee).

name: Brewers of Pennsylvania (state craft-brewers guild)
credible: Statewide craft-beer trade association; its editorial brewer features are authoritative on PA breweries.

name: Winetraveler (wine-travel editorial)
credible: Established wine-travel publication with a researched Lake Erie wineries guide; credible for wine-region coverage (paired with Pittsburgh Magazine).

name: VisitPA (Pennsylvania Tourism Office)
credible: Official Pennsylvania state tourism office listings — vetted attraction/venue info.

name: Erie Reader (Erie alt-weekly)
credible: Erie's alt-weekly of record; its crowd-voted Best of Erie awards and food features are the local editorial benchmark.

name: YourErie / WJET-WFXP (Erie ABC/Fox affiliate)
credible: Local TV news; on the Erie credible-source list.

name: Erie Times-News / GoErie
credible: Erie's daily newspaper of record; top-tier local credible source.

name: Erie Cemetery Association (official)
credible: Primary/authoritative source for the historic cemetery's history and famous residents (paired with Wikipedia).
